label: Hani 21:63 60 ms إِن stamped on the rewind to فَسۡـَٔلُوهُمۡ
notes: Raw qdc 6,[7 for 60 ms],6,7 read as a two-word phrase re-say, so إِن flashed and washed orange though it is only said once. The reciter stops after فَسۡـَٔلُوهُمۡ and says it again; CTC decodes فسألوه, فسألوهم with nothing between. The shipped row regressed in #562 (3c35b94e) when the CTC restore that had fixed it was dropped.
